what: order 0024: the feeds the news archive polls (standin/news_archive.py). status active = polled; held = not polled, not stored (the reason says why). ai_agents_named = the AI agents the feed's host or the publisher's site shut out entirely when checked; a new name holds the feed until a person looks. licence: open-government-canada | cc-by-3.0 | permission-required | publisher. full_text: the publisher whose story text is kept (Nick's decision). kind: news | statement (an office's own release, attributed) | analysis (an organisation's analysis on a date); only news is read as events. every_h: hours between polls. The third-party AP mirror is dropped (not the publisher's own feed). region and outlet_kind (public / private / state / state-funded / aggregator / intergovernmental): an item from a state outlet is said as that state's media reporting it, never as a second voice.
